meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在代码审查时输出极简评论，每条一行，格式为“行号:问题.修复.”，并用 🔴🔵 等标记问题级别；它不再赘述客套话，但对安全、架构分歧等会用完整段落解释。
howto.when: 当你说“review this PR”、“code review”或“/review”等，或要求审查 diff 时触发；审查 pull request 时也会自动触发。

say.text: 对这段代码输出一行一条的审查意见
审查时用🔴标出可能导致事故的bug

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude outputs terse one-line code review comments in the format "L<line>: <problem>. <fix>." with optional severity prefixes. It drops pleasantries, but writes full paragraphs for security/architecture/new-author cases.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "review this PR", "code review", "/review", etc., or ask to review a diff. Also auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

say_en.text: Use caveman-review to review this PR.
Give one-line review comments for this code.
Flag crash-risk bugs with 🔴 during review.
